svg.title: Natural-missingness evaluation has a narrow population
svg.desc: 382 and 1348 origins with missing current power are excluded at 15 and 60 minutes. Eligible natural family-ramp cells number 8 and 16, all at CSGS5. Other sites are not evaluable under the n=80 rule, not zero-failure cases. Repeated timestamp selections are deduplicated for pooled performance.
